searchText: Hi, quick question! for geth, how can i export all the launch parameters into the config.toml file? currently, when i try this following: `geth --datadir ./data_dir dumpconfig > config.toml` i get default values, instead of the values i am using to launch the network (e.g Network ID = 1, instead of the testnet ID that i am using ) can anyone help? also, is there a guide for setting up a bootstrap node on geth?
